description.value: Myth Szechuan Cuisine is a nature-inspired sit-down restaurant in Richmond specialising in bold Sichuan and Hunan dishes. The interior features natural wood tables, living plants, and fresh flowers, creating a calm forest-like atmosphere amid spicy, aromatic food. Takeout is available through multiple platforms, making it a feasible quick-stop option for cyclists passing through the Ackroyd Road area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack (14 spaces) at 51m; rack at 59m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is an active sit-down Szechuan/Hunan restaurant with indoor seating (corroborated by OSM indoor_seating=yes) and explicitly lists takeout and third-party delivery (TAKEOUT, UBER, FANTUAN). The website confirms the OSM address and provides a phone number absent from OSM. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so all required criteria and most optional amenities must be null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (778) 297-5678 sourced from website only — not cross-checked against OSM.
OSM address omits unit number and postal code; website provides full address '8100 Ackroyd Road #80 Richmond BC V6X 3J9'.
All three required WWC criteria are unconfirmed — listing should not proceed without verifying at least bike parking and washroom access.
